description: Traced real PROLOG_V3 mode4 path in production container. Found exact location where pre-quantization FP32/BF16 KV exists in UB before MXFP4 quantization.

bf16_write_point.exact_location: Between RmsNormNormal() call and QuantPerTileMxFp4() call
code_flow: 1. RmsNormNormal<...>(inputLocal, mmCkvKrResGm_[...], rmsnormGammaCkvLocal_, ...) — writes FP32 RMSNorm output to inputLocal (UB)
3. if constexpr (isPertile) { QuantPerTileMxFp4(outputLocal, inputLocal, sharedBuf, perTileQuantParams) } — consumes inputLocal, produces MXFP4 packed bytes
bf16_write_point.capture_point: inputLocal contains FP32 RMSNorm output AFTER RmsNormNormal, BEFORE QuantPerTileMxFp4. This is the pre-quantization KV latent.
bf16_write_point.proposed_modification: Add if constexpr (ENABLE_BF16_RING) block between RmsNormNormal and QuantPerTileMxFp4: cast FP32 to BF16 RNE, write to pre-allocated BF16 ring buffer indexed by logical position + request epoch

pipeline_full.kv_path: KV projection (matmul, mmCkvKrResGm_) -> RmsNormNormal -> [BF16 CAPTURE POINT] -> QuantPerTileMxFp4 -> ScatterCache -> kv_cache (packed400 MXFP4)
pipeline_full.kr_path: RoPE applied to kr part separately -> quant -> ScatterCache -> kr_cache

key_types.kvCacheType: uint8_t (byte view) when FP4, original type otherwise

rope_note: RoPE is applied to the kr (rope) part, NOT the main ckv path. The main ckv BF16 capture point is after RMSNorm, before quant. The kr capture would be after RoPE, before quant (separate function).
